description: Use when the user wants companies to prospect because a role in a function is new on their job board, e.g. "companies that started hiring SDRs this week". Up to 20 companies per call, each with job URL, ATS posting date, our first-seen and detection times and what we saw before. first_hire = first role of the family seen on their board since we began tracking it, not proof of a first-ever hire (founding_evidence quotes the company); surge = hiring jump. For one company: list_company_jobs.

family.description: Role family ids (1-5). Common: sdr (SDR/BDR), sales (AEs), revops, customer-success, marketing, security, data-engineering, ml-ai. All ids: sdr, sales, revops, sales-enablement, marketing-ops, sales-engineering, partnerships, customer-success, account-management, support, professional-services, marketing, product-marketing, growth-marketing, content, devrel, community, software-engineering, frontend, mobile, platform-sre, security, compliance, qa, engineering-management, hardware, it, data-engineering, data-analytics, ml-ai, product-management, design, ux-research, technical-writing, finance, legal, people, recruiting, bizops, workplace, executive, clinical, supply-chain.

include_closed.description: true = also return signals whose job post has since closed (still_open=false). Default false.

offset.description: Companies to skip; use next_offset from the previous result.

since.description: Detected in the last 7, 14 or 30 days. Default 7d.

type.description: first_hire (default) = first role of the family RoleDawn has observed on the board since tracking it (observed) or inferred on its first read (inferred), not the company's first hire ever; surge = hiring jump; all = both.

name: list_hiring_signals
title: Find companies with a new role family on their job board (sales triggers)
